description: ChemLab-G9 实验器材库。每个器材带内联 SVG 图标（24x24 stroke 风格），供虚拟实验视图渲染器材清单。

instruments.name: 试管
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 3h6M10 3v5l-4 8a3 3 0 0 0 2.7 4.5h6.6A3 3 0 0 0 18 16l-4-8V3"/><path d="M9 11h6"/></svg>
usage: 盛放少量液体或固体试剂
safety: 加热时试管口不得对着人
液体量不超过试管容积的三分之一

instruments.name: 烧杯
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 3v13a5 5 0 0 0 5 5h4a5 5 0 0 0 5-5V3"/><path d="M8 3v3M12 3v3M16 3v3"/><path d="M5 9h14"/></svg>
safety: 加热时垫石棉网
不能直接加热空烧杯

instruments.name: 酒精灯
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 3v5a4 4 0 0 1-4 4 4 4 0 0 0 4 4h8a4 4 0 0 0 4-4 4 4 0 0 1-4-4V3z"/><path d="M8 3h8"/><path d="M12 9v2.5"/><path d="M12 11.5c-1.2 0-1.8.8-1.8 1.8s.8 1.8 1.8 1.8 1.8-.8 1.8-1.8-.6-1.8-1.8-1.8z"/></svg>
safety: 用灯帽盖灭，不能用嘴吹
不可用酒精灯对点酒精灯

instruments.name: 铁架台
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 21h16"/><path d="M8 21V4h8"/><path d="M8 7h7"/><path d="M15 7v3"/></svg>
safety: 夹持试管时松紧适度
装置固定后不得用力扳动

instruments.name: 集气瓶
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M7 3h10v13a5 5 0 0 1-5 5 5 5 0 0 1-5-5z"/><path d="M7 8h10"/><path d="M9 3v3M12 3v3M15 3v3"/></svg>
safety: 磨砂面朝上并盖玻璃片
不能用于加热

instruments.name: 导管
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 18h6l3-6 3 6h6"/><path d="M9 18v-2a3 3 0 0 1 6 0v2"/></svg>
usage: 连接装置，导送气体或液体
safety: 连接时用水湿润玻璃管端口
插入橡皮塞时手握部位正确

instruments.name: 水槽
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="4" y="6" width="16" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M4 10h16"/><path d="M8 6V4h8v2"/></svg>
usage: 排水法收集气体的容器
safety: 水位不宜过满
实验结束先移导管再熄灯防止倒吸

instruments.name: 温度计
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3v9a4 4 0 1 0 4 4V3z"/><path d="M12 15h.01M12 17h.01M12 13h.01"/><path d="M9 3h6"/></svg>
safety: 测量时不能接触容器底部或壁
不能当玻璃棒搅拌

instruments.name: 玻璃棒
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 20L20 4"/><circle cx="5" cy="19" r="1.2" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="19" cy="5" r="1.2" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
safety: 搅拌时不能碰撞容器壁
使用后及时清洗

instruments.name: 量筒
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 3h6M9 3v16a3 3 0 0 0 3 3 3 3 0 0 0 3-3V3"/><path d="M8 3h8"/><path d="M10 7h4M10 11h4M10 15h4"/></svg>
safety: 不能用于加热或配制溶液
读数时视线与凹液面最低处相平

instruments.name: 胶头滴管
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 3h4M12 3v4M9 7h6l-2 6h-2z"/><path d="M10 13h4"/><path d="M10 16h4"/></svg>
safety: 胶头在上，不能倒置
滴管不能伸入容器内接触液面

instruments.name: 镊子
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 4l4 5M19 4l-4 5"/><path d="M9 9l-3 10M15 9l3 10"/></svg>
usage: 夹取固体药品或块状物
safety: 夹取后轻放，不抛掷
夹热物体时注意防护

instruments.name: 剪刀
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="2.5"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="2.5"/><path d="M8 7l12 9M8 17l12-9"/></svg>
safety: 不指向他人，用后归位

instruments.name: 蜡烛
instruments.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 4h4v14a3 3 0 0 1-3 3 3 3 0 0 1-3-3z"/><path d="M12 1v3"/><path d="M12 3c1.5 0 2 1.5 0 2.5"/></svg>
safety: 点燃须在教师指导下进行
火焰附近不放易燃物
